capabilities: Create, rename, delete, collapse, and reorder mind map nodes with multi-select and undo
Link nodes to existing vault notes by search or create new notes from nodes
Switch between outline and radial layout modes
Compile a map's outline with its linked notes into a single full-note document
Import note lists as mind maps and export maps as outlines
extras: Bilingual English/Korean README; MIT license; donation links and community-review fixes listed in update history.
motivation: The author built a clean, no-frills mind-mapping tool optimized for effective writing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in mind-mapping tool for visually brainstorming and structuring writing inside the vault.
summary: Keyboard-centric mind map plugin that edits nodes with hotkeys, links nodes to vault notes, and compiles maps into documents.
